title: OperatorRecord
description: A record in the closed BANZA Technical Registry for an OPERATOR — the responsible entity (ADR-038 §4.2/§4.3, §13). An operator publishes zero or more implementations; the operator is the entity responsible, the implementation is the technical system evaluated. Presence of a record NEVER implies admission to a scheme, regulatory authorisation, or the ability to move funds (ADR-038 §4.10, ADR-004). Documentary/reference contract — mirrors the Rust `banza-target-registry` OperatorRecord; it introduces no new financial invariant.
_authority: ADR-038 (endpoint-originated operator validation & operator–implementation model), ADR-036 (technical registry), ADR-043 (Rust-first engines)
_boundary: Registry presence is a technical fact only. It is not certification, scheme admission, or regulatory authorisation, and it never lets any entity move funds.

operator_id.description: Stable operator identifier (a lowercase slug, e.g. 'operator-zero'). Operator-agnostic; never a commercial brand.

publication_status.description: Lifecycle state of the record. Only 'published' is an eligible validation target; every other value is a typed ineligibility reason during resolution.

implementation_ids.description: The implementation ids this operator publishes. An implementation is only resolvable if the operator lists it here AND it belongs to this operator.

registry_ref.description: Reference of this record inside the technical registry (e.g. 'banza-technical-registry:operator-zero').
